title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates E = mg tanθ/q = 100000 N/C.

title: Minimum mechanical energy
description: Essential: Final answer for part (2) is 3.85 J (or equivalent).

title: Force balance at C
description: Important: Applies static equilibrium at point C with tension, gravity, and electric force.

title: Newton's law at D
description: Important: Uses N2L at the far-right point D to find minimum speed v_D = 2.5 m/s.

title: Work-energy application
description: Important: Applies work-energy theorem between D and the top-right point to find kinetic energy 2.25 J.

title: Energy conservation setup
description: Important: Correctly identifies minimum mechanical energy as sum of gravitational and kinetic energies at appropriate point.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units throughout calculations.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong sign for electric potential energy change in work-energy theorem.

title: Forgetting tension at D
description: Pitfall: Omits that net centripetal force at D comes from vector sum of mg and qE, not just gravity.
